tagline: Handmade crochet keychains and accessories from Ciputat, with an export-market orientation.

story.title: Handmade crochet keychains and accessories from Ciputat, with an export-market orientation.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi Tangerang Selatan lists Fennycroche under Fenny Luckyharti in Ciputat. The curated listing records crochet keychains in multiple models/characters, 50 pcs/month capacity, a public selling range of Rp25,000–Rp225,000, export as the target market and HAKI trademark status.
